column2: How do I link the pages of one document and transcribe them together?
column3: On the document page (Documents tab) or in the viewer: “📑 Document pages” → “＋ Link another page…”. As many pages as needed, each with its name (Front, Back, Page 3, Appendix or a free name), put in order by dragging ⠿; “Remove from the set” and “↶ Undo”; a page belongs to only one document. The 📜 Transcription workshop then opens all the pages, as tabs above the image: one text split by “— page 2 —” (recommended) or one text per page (⋯ menu of the tabs). “✨ Read ▾” reads the page shown or all of them, and “What the app found” gives the page and line of each piece of information (“page 3, line 7”), also written in the source.
